change_summary: PLOS ONE issued an Expression of Concern on this article to inform readers of unresolved issues. The notice says the Fig. 7 results do not match the legend or Results text, and the LSD1 siRNA migration statement is not supported. The notice reports a possible vertical discontinuity in the LSD1 panel of Fig. 4. The notice says similarities with other groups' work call into question the validity and provenance of the results, and the authors did not respond. The stored paper's Results state that LSD1 siRNA reduced migration in H460 cells and that A549 expression was lower than H460 per Figure 4.
evaluation: Your Background section cites [12] for LSD1 over-expression being associated with shorter overall survival, and the stored paper reports that association. The notice says similarities with other groups' work call into question the validity and provenance of the reported results, so this background use may be touched, but the notice names no specific problem with the survival data and it is only context for your plan. Your Rationale for Aim 2 cites Lv et al. [12] for the H460 siRNA scratch-assay result and takes it as the clearest indication that LSD1 drives migration, and the stored paper reports that result. The notice says the Fig. 7 results do not correspond to the legend or Results text, which hits the result your central hypothesis leans on, and you call this single study the main evidence for that hypothesis. Overall the impact is moderate: the Rationale use is directly affected, while the Background use is only possibly affected.
recommendation: The notice says the Fig. 7 results do not correspond to the legend or Results text, and your draft takes that knockdown result as the clearest indication that LSD1 drives migration. Hedge that wording, cite the notice, and don't build Aim 2 on this result alone. The notice says similarities with other groups' work call into question the validity and provenance of the reported results, and your Background cites [12] for the survival association. Add a caveat and cite the notice there too, and keep tracking the paper.

alerts.what_changed: PLOS ONE issued an Expression of Concern: a possible splice in the Fig. 4 LSD1 blot, Fig. 7 not matching its legend and text (no LSD1 siRNA data), insufficient control detail for the transfection experiments, and similarities to other groups' work questioning validity and provenance. The authors did not respond.
